summary:
Built the runtime patcher on top of the Phase 0 skeleton. Five channels, each chosen for the narrowest reach that still works, plus a 114-assertion node test that drives the shipping functions directly.

THE CENTRAL RE-DERIVATION THAT RESHAPED THE WHOLE DESIGN: `client/applications/ui/notifications.mjs:121` is `message = _loc(message, format);` — UNCONDITIONAL, independent of the `{localize}` option (that option only gates the cleanHTML exemption at :116/:119). `_loc` is `Localization#localize` (client/global.d.mts:32). So every STATIC English literal handed to ui.notifications is reachable by a flat top-level i18n key, no notify shim needed. The shim shrank from "9 notification literals" to the 3 that are template strings and structurally out of reach.

CHANNEL A — 9 top-level i18n keys (i18nInit): 4 static notification literals + 5 Dice So Nice registrations. DSN was verified to route colorset.description / colorset.category / system.name through game.i18n.localize (prepareColorsetList / prepareSystemList in modules/dice-so-nice/main.js). Global conflict surface measured = 0 across 201 deduped lang JSONs (core + every installed system and module); the measurement is now a permanent gate (test group C2).

CHANNEL A-prime — settings-menu retarget: init.mjs:38/39/40 registerMenu name/label/hint are English literals while ALIENRPG.forceImportName/Label/Hint are translated and have ZERO references upstream. I repoint game.settings.menus at those keys rather than injecting 3 English top-level keys, so the strings stay in the cheap lang channel. Three `expect` fuses: if upstream ever edits the literal, the patch declines and logs instead of guessing. Verified registerMenu stores data raw (client-settings.mjs:185-194) and localization happens at render (settings/config.mjs:59-64 -> templates/settings/config-category.hbs:4/10/14).

CHANNEL B — 2 whole-template overrides only, where the trade is worth it: planet-general.hbs (32 label elements, exactly 1 {{localize}} in the whole file) and creature-header.hbs (the 4 data-label attributes that flow into JS). Everything with one or two plain-text strings went to DOM instead, because a whole-file override of a 281-line template for one word goes stale silently.

CHANNEL C — DOM, 5 text rules + 4 attribute rules + the @DRAW tooltip rule. Every rule carries three independent narrowing conditions: a scope selector (`.alienrpg` — verified as classes[0] on all 8 sheet classes; `#alienprgSettings` for the appv1 config), a system-owned selector, and whole-string equality. Where an i18n key exists the rule resolves it at apply time (`{key: 'ALIENRPG.Stunts'}`) so the string stays translatable rather than being hardcoded Chinese.

CHANNEL D — notify shim, 3 fully `^...$`-anchored patterns, installed at `ready` (ui.notifications is created at game.mjs:764, between setup:740 and ready:779).

CHANNEL E — preCreateChatMessage (5 rules) / preCreateItem (1 rule), each with a STRUCTURAL anchor beyond text: flags.core.initiativeRoll for the initiative flavour, speaker.alias equality for the devmsg byline, `type === 'critical-injury'` for the crit-item glue.

Plus a queueMicrotask-based `renderGamePause` fix that is hook-order-independent and restores core's own GAME.Paused instead of hardcoding Chinese.

TEST RESULT: 114 PASS / 0 FAIL, exit 0. Group B (36 negative assertions) includes the previous project's actual accident string ('Mirror Image does not exist!'), other modules' notifications, prose containing the same words, off-by-one-character variants, Error objects, and structurally-similar-but-unanchored documents — every one passes through byte-identical.

decisions.decision: Moved template pre-registration from `init` to `i18nInit`, and corrected my own first draft which had gated it on `game.i18n.lang` at `init`.
decisions.reason: Re-derived from source: localization.mjs:10-19 sets `this.lang` from the SERVER default in the constructor; the world/client language is only read at :80 and only assigned at :231 inside setLanguage(), which runs from initialize() at game.mjs:663 — AFTER callAll('init') at :652. So at `init`, `game.i18n.lang` is the server default: a Chinese world can read 'en' (silent no-op) and an English world can read 'cn' (silent mis-translation). Both directions wrong. `game.settings.get('core','language')` is not a fallback either — core settings register at game.mjs:660, also after init. i18nInit is the first hook after setLanguage() and is still long before any Actor sheet renders (initializeUI at :764 renders only core singletons).

decisions.decision: Gated the ENTIRE file on `game.i18n.lang === 'cn'`; in any other language it is a complete no-op.
decisions.reason: Channel A writes top-level keys into the globally-shared game.i18n.translations, and channel B swaps in already-Chinese templates. Both would corrupt an English world. module.json's lang/cn.json already only loads at lang==='cn'; the patcher now matches it.

decisions.decision: Used flat top-level i18n keys for the 4 static notification literals instead of a notify shim.
decisions.reason: notifications.mjs:121 localizes unconditionally. This removes 4 patterns from the one global hook in the file. It is also inherently safer than a regex: a collision requires the WHOLE English string to be identical, in which case the Chinese translation is correct for the colliding caller too — structurally unlike the substring-regex failure that produced '镜子 Image 不存在！'.

decisions.decision: Repointed the settings menu at ALIENRPG.forceImportName/Label/Hint rather than translating the literals.
decisions.reason: Task guidance, and the keys are semantically right: forceImportHint says 'will not overwrite existing data but will replace missing data', which is exactly what ReImport() (init.mjs:132-172) does, and is MORE accurate than upstream's 'Welcome to the Alien RPG System...' hint. Keeps the strings in lang/cn.json where upstream text edits can't silently desync them. Same reasoning applied to ALIENRPG.NPC / Stunts / SPECIALTY / CreateItemTitle in the DOM rules.

decisions.decision: 'Colors' (the DSN colorset category at alienrpg.mjs:387/398) resolves DICESONICE.Colors at runtime rather than being a hardcoded Chinese string.
decisions.reason: DSN's own colorsets use category 'DICESONICE.Colors' (→ '颜色' in its zh_Hans.json, which it declares for lang 'cn'). The grouping key in prepareColorsetList is the LOCALIZED category string. Hardcoding a different Chinese word would keep the two alienrpg colorsets in a separate group; resolving DSN's actual value merges them into DSN's existing group. Same mechanism used for 'Yellow' → DICESONICE.ColorYellow, with a '黄色' fallback if DSN is absent.

decisions.decision: Only 2 whole-template overrides; everything else routed to DOM.
decisions.reason: A whole-file override is the highest-maintenance patch shape (upstream edits are lost silently, no error). It earns its keep for planet-general.hbs (32 hardcoded labels, 1 localize call) and creature-header.hbs (61 lines, and the strings are ATTRIBUTES that feed JS). It does not earn its keep for crtui-character-general.hbs (281 lines) or crtui-synthetic-general.hbs (267 lines), which have ONE hardcoded word each (<label>SPECIALTY</label>) — those got a 1-line DOM rule with selector `label.speciality-label`.

decisions.decision: Did NOT patch 'Vehicle inceptions are not allowed!' (spacecraft-sheet.mjs:392, vehicle-sheet.mjs:388).
decisions.reason: The guard is `crew.type === "vehicles" && crew.type === "spacecraft"` — tautologically false, one value cannot equal both. The notification is unreachable. Patching it would be a rule that can never fire.

decisions.decision: Did NOT patch module/apps/update.js's allDone() English, despite the task naming update.js as an unscanned live file.
decisions.reason: I scanned it (it IS live — imported by init.mjs:1). Its visible English (`${moduleTitle} Update`, 'The update has completed and the following have been updated:', label 'Okay!') sits in allDone(), which is unreachable in 4.1.13: `const updateAssets = []` at :23-24 makes `!updateAssets.length` true at :29, and updateModule() returns at :32-33 before ever calling allDone(). Reported instead of patched.

decisions.decision: Did NOT patch 4 template sites the audit listed: 'Hello World', the 2 crt/territory-sheet.html titles, and templates/system/alienprgSettings.hbs.
decisions.reason: Reachability analysis from the 62-file live import graph plus transitive {{> }} partial following: all four live in templates that NOTHING references. In particular the settings template the audit points at is dead — alienRPGConfig.mjs:12 loads `systems/alienrpg/module/helpers/alienprgSettings.hbs`, a SECOND copy under module/helpers/. My CRT-UI-Sheets DOM rule targets the live copy.

decisions.decision: Test imports the shipping .mjs via a `const HOOKS = globalThis.Hooks ?? {on(){},once(){}}` shim rather than testing a copy.
decisions.reason: The whole point of the negative test is 'other packages' strings pass through OUR shipping function untouched'. A copied fixture proves nothing about what ships. The shim is a 1-line, documented, behaviour-identical indirection in Foundry.

UPSTREAM BUG, not fixed by us: actor.mjs:2249 renders `systems/alienrpg/templates/roll-spacecraft-major-crit-dialog.hbs` — the `dialog/` segment is missing and no such file exists, so the manual spacecraft MAJOR crit dialog cannot render. actor.mjs:2233 has a double slash (`templates/dialog//roll-syn-manual-crit-dialog.hbs`). We could incidentally fix the first by pre-registering a partial under the broken id, but that is a functional fix disguised as a translation and I left it out — flagging for an owner decision.

On those two sheets the stunt button throws on `li2.classList`. The register already notes those two call sites are UNGATED by the evolved setting; the deeper problem is they have no panel at all.

LATENT LOCKSTEP for the Babele slice: the 4 `chatData.startsWith('

No Stunts Entered

')` comparisons are DEAD today because the left operand `temp3.startsWith('
    ')` short-circuits (the 12 ALIENRPG. keys do not exist in en.json — already recorded in the register's dead_second_leg). So translating that heading in the 11 skill-stunts item descriptions is safe NOW, and becomes a lockstep the moment upstream restores those keys.

UPSTREAM CONFLICT with Dice So Nice: alienrpg.mjs:385 calls addColorset({name:"yellow", ...}), and DSN ships a BUILT-IN colorset also named "yellow" (description DICESONICE.ColorYellow). The system silently overwrites DSN's yellow with its own foreground/background. That is why our label resolves DICESONICE.ColorYellow rather than inventing a new Chinese word — but the underlying overwrite is an upstream defect worth reporting to pwatson100.

PHASE 1 LANG DEPENDENCY: channel A-prime now routes the settings menu through ALIENRPG.forceImportName/Label/Hint. Those three keys are currently UNUSED upstream, so the lang slice may skip them as dead weight. They are no longer dead — the module cn.json must carry good values or users see upstream's machine translations ('强制重新导入，就像这是模块的初始启动一样。'). Same for ALIENRPG.NPC, Stunts, SPECIALTY, CreateItemTitle, Speed, Skillmobility, Skillobservation, SkillAcidSplash, which the DOM rules and the creature-header override now consume.

ALIENRPG.NPC ships as 'NPC' in both en and cn, so the `>NPC?<` DOM rule is a deliberate no-op today (it resolves to 'NPC?' and the code skips when to === from). It exists so the string is in the lang channel if anyone later wants 非玩家角色.

ALIENRPG.SkillAcidSplash cn is '酸性血液' while glossary_alien.json says Acid Splash = 酸血飞溅. The creature-header override now feeds that lang value into BOTH the visible label and the dialog title, so the mismatch becomes doubly visible. Phase 1 lang slice should reconcile. Same class of problem: ALIENRPG.ArmorVsFire cn = '护甲 V 火' (machine translation of 'Armor V Fire').

TIMING GAP, accepted and documented in the file: the notify shim installs at `ready` because ui.notifications is only constructed at game.mjs:764. A logger.error fired by the system's own ready handler before ours would leak the English '| ERROR |' prefix. Fixing it would require patching Notifications.prototype — a strictly wider blast radius than the instance patch, so I did not.

NOT PATCHED, flagged instead: CBTracker.mjs's swap-initiative Dialog has `label: "OK"`. appv1 Dialog does localize button labels, so a top-level key would work — but 'OK' is far too generic to claim as a global i18n key, and core's own cn already renders OK acceptably.

13 unreachable templates carry English that a naive scanner will keep reporting forever (7 in templates/actor/tabs/, 6 under templates/actor/crt/ plus inline/ and system/). Worth adding the reachability analysis to a permanent QA script so the next audit does not re-litigate them.
